claims.statement: For orthonormal r1,r2 and alpha,beta>0, if X has independent scalar densities <=1 then alpha<r1,X>^2+beta<r2,X>^2 has density L-infinity <=2*pi/sqrt(alpha*beta).
For orthonormal r1,r2,r3 and alpha,beta,gamma>=1, the rank-three form alpha<r1,X>^2+beta<r2,X>^2-gamma<r3,X>^2 has density <=sqrt(2)*pi a.e. on s>0; reflected statement holds for signature (1,2).
Control the two-sheet/minority-sign levels and/or pass the ruled-level estimate through correlated additional spectral components while retaining original product structure.

dependencies.scope: every k-dimensional orthogonal marginal of product density with scalar caps 1 is <=2^(k/2)
same-sign spectral determinant mass and fixed-physical-block delocalization obstruction
hyperbolic-square physical theorem and reciprocal-Pluecker averaging obstruction
